pricing.care_included: Technical support included in the subscription
pricing.usage_included: AI, telephony and SMS within agreed limits
pricing.other_care: Support from 400 PLN/month applies to websites, automations and other bespoke deployments. Support is already included in the Bot + phone system subscription.
pricing.bundle_faq_question: What does the 899 PLN monthly subscription include?
pricing.bundle_faq_answer: The Bot + phone system subscription includes system use, maintenance and technical support, plus AI, telephony and SMS costs within agreed limits. Call and SMS allowances, support scope and additional usage rates are specified in the offer before launch. One-off deployment and major extensions are billed separately.
offer.ivrScope: 1 number and an IVR menu with up to 3 options
offer.changes.ivr: 15 minutes of minor changes per month
offer.changes.bot: 30 minutes of minor changes per month
offer.changes.combo: 60 minutes of minor changes per month
offer.finalPrices: Final amounts payable. VAT is included where applicable.
offer.launch: Launch terms for 3 new AI deployments. Availability is confirmed in your individual offer. The basic scope covers one process and one standard integration; additional features are quoted before work starts.
offer.limits: Notification at 80% usage. New paid calls and SMS stop at the limit until an additional budget is approved. Default extra budget: 0 PLN. Unused minutes, SMS and change time do not roll over.
offer.meter: Minutes are rounded up separately for each call and billable forwarding leg. SMS are counted in billable segments; long texts or Polish characters may increase the count. Maximum AI call duration: 5 minutes; IVR-forwarded call: 15 minutes.
offer.extras: After extra charges are approved: IVR 1.49 PLN/min, AI 2.49 PLN/min, SMS 0.69 PLN/segment. Additional work: 160 PLN/hour, subject to an agreed quote. Fixing defects against the accepted scope does not use the minor-change allowance.
offer.support: Support: Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00 Polish time, excluding public holidays. Critical incident response within 8 working hours; other requests within 2 business days. Response time is not a repair deadline.
offer.payments: Deployment: 50% upfront and the balance after acceptance. Subscription paid in advance; invoice due in 7 days. Notice period: 30 days, effective at the end of a monthly billing period. Delivery dates are confirmed after materials and access are received.
offer.otherScope: Website from 1,990 PLN: one page with up to 6 sections in one language, using client materials. Automation from 990 PLN: one workflow connecting up to 2 apps. Extra pages, CMS, languages, paid licences and expansions are quoted separately.
offer.otherCare: Optional website care from 149 PLN/month includes monitoring, a configuration backup and 15 minutes of minor changes. Automation care from 399 PLN/month includes 30 minutes of changes. Domains, website hosting and client licences are billed separately. Phone packages already include support.
offer.bundleFaq: The package includes 250 call minutes, 100 SMS segments, AI, telephony, one process with conversation branches, one standard integration and 60 minutes of minor changes per month. Deployment is charged separately. Limits and extra rates are listed with the pricing; additional usage requires approval.
legal.v2.privacy_draft: This description needs to be completed with the controller’s full identity, provider details, transfer arrangements and retention periods. It describes the current website; it does not confirm that the information required by the GDPR is complete.
legal.v2.controller: DAWKOZ is Dawid Kozula’s brand. The controller’s full identity and address still need to be confirmed; a brand name alone does not identify the party responsible for processing personal data.
legal.v2.privacy_contact: Please send privacy questions and requests for further information to the email address provided.
legal.v2.public_functions: The public website has no form that sends data to the server and no online payments. Contact links open an email application. The copy button writes DAWKOZ’s address to the clipboard without reading its previous contents.
legal.v2.document_panel: The private /app panel is used by the DAWKOZ operator to prepare documents. It does not provide customer accounts. Document fields and imported projects remain in the tab’s memory; they are not sent to the server or automatically saved in browser storage. Downloaded files need to be protected on your own device.
legal.v2.demo: The public customer panel demonstration uses sample data only. Changes remain in the tab’s memory and disappear when the page is reloaded. It is not a customer account or a place to submit documents or real personal data.
legal.v2.no_tracking: The public website’s code contains no analytics, advertising pixels or advertising cookies. The private panel uses an essential session cookie after login.
legal.v2.session_cookie: The dawkoz_panel_session cookie maintains the operator’s /app session for up to 8 hours. It is marked HttpOnly and SameSite=Strict, and Secure in production. Logging out removes the cookie and invalidates the session; restarting the server also invalidates sessions. The cookie is not used for advertising.
legal.v2.ovh: — domain and email services, to the extent used in the actual configuration.
legal.v2.cloudflare: — DNS services and, when the proxy is enabled, traffic proxying. The actual scope and data recipients need to be confirmed in the domain configuration.
legal.v2.billing_recipient: Data needed to enter into a contract and handle billing may be shared with the actual seller or its authorised accounting service. The recipient, purpose and scope must be identified before the contract is concluded; no automatic access by another company to requests or calls has been agreed.
legal.v2.suppliers_missing: The providers’ relevant legal entities, service regions, retention, data processing agreements and any transfers outside the EEA and their safeguards still need to be confirmed. Merely naming a provider does not establish these arrangements.
legal.v2.retention_panel: Panel sessions expire after 8 hours, logout or a process restart. Failed login attempts are counted for 15 minutes. The application does not keep a server-side archive of data entered into documents; users determine how long to protect downloaded files.
legal.v2.securitypurpose: Protecting the panel and preventing unauthorised access, including limiting login attempts — Article 6(1)(f) GDPR; the legitimate interest is the security of the services.
legal.v2.provider_cookie_missing: Additional cookies, logs and protection settings provided by the hosting service or CDN need to be checked in the live configuration. Describing the application code does not establish how all external services behave.
legal.v2.terms_draft: This describes the collaboration process and is not a final contract. The seller’s full details, responsibility, tax status and terms for the specific customer need to be settled before an order is accepted.
legal.v2.seller_missing: DAWKOZ is a brand. Before entering into a contract, the customer must receive the seller’s full business name or personal name, address, and relevant registration and tax details. The contact person is not necessarily the contracting party.
legal.v2.price_final: Amounts in the current price list are final amounts payable, including VAT if applicable. A price stated as “from” requires confirmation of the scope and final quote. The seller’s VAT status and details are specified in the offer and contract.
legal.v2.terms_billing: Dawid Kozula may perform the work under the actual collaboration arrangements. The seller, contractor responsible to the customer and invoice issuer must match the contractual arrangements; an invoice issued by another company alone does not establish that the arrangement is valid.
legal.v2.terms_missing: The seller’s full details and the basis of collaboration with the person performing the work still need to be confirmed. This website does not attribute consent to sell, responsibility or an invoicing obligation to another company.
legal.v2.terms_ai: Before a bot is activated, its scenarios, handoff to a person and handling of incorrect answers are tested. AI can make mistakes. Actions requiring a binding decision, booking confirmation or document approval must be explicitly agreed and tested.
legal.v2.data_draft: This describes planned implementations. The controller, contractor and providers must be identified for each specific system. This page does not confirm that data processing agreements have been concluded or that the service is ready to process customer data.
legal.v2.data_contact: DAWKOZ’s contact person is Dawid Kozula. Questions about the website and planned implementations:
legal.v2.data_billing: Data needed for an invoice may be processed by the actual seller and its authorised accounting service. This does not imply access to requests, calls, transcripts or customer documents.
legal.v2.data_roles: Before data is made available to any party, its role, purpose, scope of access and appropriate legal basis are defined. The contractor’s identity and billing arrangements need to be confirmed before an order is placed.
legal.v2.data_ai: Callers should receive clear information that they are speaking to AI. Recording or storing transcripts requires separate arrangements for the purpose, legal basis, retention and information given to callers. Calling a bot is not consent to every use of the conversation.
legal.v2.data_invoices: Invoice automation requires agreement on which data is extracted, who may verify it and how errors are handled. Reading a document with AI does not mean that it has been correctly booked, submitted to Poland’s KSeF system or approved for payment.
credibility.credibility.testsText: We check the workflow before launch
credibility.credibility.caseDescription: Example scenario: an AI assistant collects information during a call and sends a structured request to the business. The presentation uses fictional data.
offer.faqAnswers: A knowledge base of up to 20 agreed answers
offer.includedTitle: What does a bot deployment include?
offer.conversationTitle: A conversation that fits the request
offer.conversationScope: One process, such as taking a fault report, can include conversation branches, follow-up questions and ways to handle missing information. Using the client’s materials, we prepare up to 20 approved answers to questions about that process. One process does not mean a single fixed script.
offer.handoffTitle: A request ready for your team
offer.integrationDetail: The bot collects the agreed information and sends a summary to one tool: email, Telegram or a spreadsheet. AI, telephony and SMS within the package limits do not count as extra integrations. Custom APIs and additional tools are quoted separately.
offer.testingScope: Testing with the client, two rounds of feedback on the process, operating instructions and a monthly usage report. Fixing defects against the agreed scope does not use the minor-change allowance. A separate client portal account is quoted as an additional service.
offer.trafficAdvice: The AI package includes 200 minutes and Bot + switchboard includes 250 minutes. We choose the package based on call volume and duration; forwarded calls may use more than one billable leg. Higher call volumes are quoted before activation.
automation.v1.intro: Choose one recurring task in your business. We agree on a focused scope, connect the tools you need and test the full workflow before launch.
automation.v1.inquiriesDescription: Form submissions arrive in an organised list where your team can follow them up.
automation.v1.inquiriesDetails: One agreed form and one spreadsheet, up to 2 applications. Defined fields, required-data checks and a submission-delivery test.
automation.v1.remindersDescription: Notifications follow an agreed rule, so each appointment does not need a manual reminder.
automation.v1.remindersDetails: For example, a calendar → email or SMS 24 hours before an appointment, excluding cancelled entries. SMS and tool charges are billed separately.
automation.v1.invoicesDescription: Invoice data goes into a spreadsheet for an employee to check before it is used further.
automation.v1.invoicesScope: 1 mailbox, 1 PDF type, up to 5 fields
automation.v1.invoicesDetails: One agreed type of text-based PDF and a review queue. Scanning/OCR and KSeF require a separate quote. Automatic bookkeeping is outside this scope.
automation.v1.priceNote: Final payable prices, including VAT where applicable. These are starting scopes; integrations, data access and retention are agreed in an individual quote. Licences, hosting and ongoing service usage are billed separately.
automation.v1.careNote: Ongoing automation support is optional, from 399 PLN/month. Its scope and limits are agreed before signing.
automation.v1.panelDescription: Enquiries, statuses, documents and usage in one place. Start in the browser, with the option to develop a PWA or app later.
automation.v1.panelNote: Portal implementation is quoted separately. Hosting, a database, backups and integrations require an agreed budget.
automation.v1.demoNote: Public preview in Polish. Sample data only.
